definitions.explanation: A shape with four sides and four angles.

{四角|しかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
⟦{正方形|せいほうけい}→正方形：05438_seihoukei⟧

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四角|しかく}い→四角い：05917_shikakui⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ね→積み重ねる：06235_tsumikasaneru⟧⟦やすい→～やすい：18367_yasui⟧。
examples.english: This box has a square shape, so it's easy to stack.

notes:
{四角|しかく} is a general term for any four-sided shape — squares, rectangles, and other quadrilaterals. It is the everyday word; for precise geometric terms, see below.

FORMS:
- {四角|しかく} (noun): a square/rectangle
- ⟦{四角|しかく}い→四角い：05917_shikakui⟧ (i-adjective): square-shaped, boxy — the most natural adjectival form
- {四角|しかく}な (na-adjective): less common in everyday speech

PRECISE GEOMETRIC TERMS:
- ⟦{正方形|せいほうけい}→正方形：05438_seihoukei⟧: square (all sides equal)
- ⟦{長方形|ちょうほうけい}→長方形：05439_chouhoukei⟧: rectangle
- ⟦{四角形|しかくけい}→四角形：05437_shikakukei⟧: quadrilateral (formal/mathematical)

RELATED SHAPES:
- ⟦{三角|さんかく}→三角：04177_sankaku⟧: triangle
- ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧: circle
- ⟦{丸|まる}い→丸い：02967_marui⟧: round (i-adjective)

USAGE:
In everyday conversation, ⟦{四角|しかく}い→四角い：05917_shikakui⟧ is used broadly to describe anything boxy or rectangular: ⟦{四角|しかく}い→四角い：05917_shikakui⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧ (square box), ⟦{四角|しかく}い→四角い：05917_shikakui⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (square face).
